title: Mixed Event — Insatiable Pale Color

meta.Outline: While Kanade and the others embrace Nightcord at 25:00's rising popularity, Ena's illustration account remains stagnant. Ena then sets her sights on an art competition...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K, I finished writing the lyrics for our new song.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You're hitting a new theme with this one! Yuki is showing us a different side of her personality.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <How can you write something this good without putting any thought into it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Intuition, I guess? It must take a lot of talent. That's what I thought when I heard your OWN songs too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That reminds me! Marionette has got so many views now, you wouldn't believe it!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We even got comments from famous artists. It's attracting a lot of attention!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You weren't kidding. We never had this many comments before!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <The illustrations were also very good this time.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <The images changing to match the lyrics during the chorus really makes you feel a complex range of emotions.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh...! That's from the same person who always comments on my illustrations.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (They can tell what I was trying to do...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Looks like we're finally garnering some fame for ourselves!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Well, not that fame matters to K or Yuki....>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It makes me happy to know that our songs are reaching so many people out there...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Maybe they'll even make a difference in someone's life.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hehe. I guess that part of you will never change, K.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But having that kind of impact would be nice.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Can our songs really achieve that? I haven't really been going for anything like that at all.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We know, Enanan. All you care about is getting lots of likes♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, don't make me sound so superficial.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I hit the nail on the head, didn't I?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <O-Of course I want my artwork to be seen by as many people as possible...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But I'm not drawing just for likes. I enjoy making illustrations, simple as that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <In other words, it's your passion. That's pretty cool!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <To be fair, I'm not surprised we hit the jackpot with this song. The video I made for it was one of my best works yet!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And your artwork was a cut above your usual stuff too, Enanan♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, what do you mean by my usual stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I also really liked your artwork. The imagery reflected the feel of the song and meshed well with the lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You value her compliments more than mine? No fair.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Moving on, let's finish up our new song. We only have a little bit to go before it's ready to upload.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
K really liked my art...
Genuinely...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe, that makes me even more motivated.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll probably have to pull an all-nighter again, which means I'll need snacks.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Perfect timing. Can you grab me a custard pudding from the refrigerator?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Grab me a juice too. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm busy, you know. Go get them yourself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's gotten into him? It was just a small favor, sheesh.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Fine. Guess I have to go downstairs myself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Why is he still awake this late...?!)

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: You don't have talent. You'll never become an artist.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (N25's songs have been getting more views, and people are even praising my illustrations in the comments!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (My illustration account isn't getting more followers...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The pictures I uploaded are getting hardly any likes, let alone comments...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I guess that makes sense. I haven't mentioned in the account's profile that I do illustrations for N25.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I could probably get more followers if I dropped our group name but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want my art to be judged purely for what it is.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want to be known as an artist in my own right, not just as N25's illustrator!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, where did I put that plushie I got from Akito's friend the other day...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I bet it'll look cute in a photo.
I think I'll use it for today's post.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wish you'd post more often... I want to see this every day... Love!...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A photo that takes me less than five minutes to take gets an immediate response...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess this means I really don't...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (As long as I do, someone will eventually appreciate my art...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Keep it down, Amia.
It's like you're yelling right into my ear.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Why? You and I are the only ones here anyway, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And I'm telling you to pipe down!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <*Sigh*... I think I'll log off now. There's only a few minor adjustments left to make so...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then I'll log off after I get a look at it♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No way. Not until it's completely done.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Aww, not even just a tiny little peek? It'll help me with the video if I know what sort of imagery I should be focusing on too, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You say that, but I know you just want to look at it...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Come to think of it, Yuki left at her usual time, but K left pretty early today. I wonder if she had something to do?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, she said it's her day to go to the hospital.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, right... She can only visit during the day.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Why don't you get some sunshine for a change too, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No, by actually going outside. You never know, it might feel good.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're one to talk. Plus, aren't you about to go to bed?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yup♪ Staying up late is bad for the skin so...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So I think I'll leave things here. Later, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll brush my teeth and go to bed too then...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You stayed up all night again?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And what if I did?
Just go to school already, will you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I doubt a night school student would know, but I still have plenty of time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh? Thanks for the tip, not like I care or anything.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, they're some art exhibit flyers dad brought home. It's just never-ending with him.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know, right? They just keep piling up, so I wish he'd stop bringing them home.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait... This piece is by that artist I like...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Shibuya Art Contest...
This person won last time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Sigh... It must be nice to win something like this...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And this contest is a pretty serious one at that, so I can't possibly...)
Do you want to enter in the contest?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wh-What's it to you...?
It's my choice, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: But this contest attracts artists that are as good as actual professionals every year.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: So you don't stand a chance.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...?! Oh, I get it. I'm too talentless or not worthy of entering into this contest, aren't I?

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: That's not what I'm saying. I just think it'll be difficult to win any of the prizes.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: But if that doesn't bother you, then go right on ahead.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Won't stand a chance? Can't win anything? What if I can? I won't know unless I try, right?!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've never entered into any big contests like this before, so I have no idea what's going to happen...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I'm sure to get recognition if I win something!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's it... I'm gonna win it all in this contest!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And the paint is... Oh, here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I know that I decided to make a submission for this contest, but going out to buy supplies after an all-nighter feels...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, I don't really have a choice. My old paint is all dried up after not being used for so long.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, Kanade!
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I was visiting my father.
How about you?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I... Um...
I was getting art supplies.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow, you're entering into a contest?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it's a pretty big one too. Some of the other artists are practically pros too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, anyone can submit a piece so it's really nothing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. It's just that... I've never been in a contest like this before so I'm just a little worried is all...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I mean... I'm wondering if I can do a good job.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't know much about actual art, but I can tell you this at least...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So please give it your best shot.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm home...
Oh, right. There's no one here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. But I'm happy that I ran into Kanade today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(And I'll put a shadow in here...
There. Looks good!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This motif sort of loses its impact...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've heard that ambiguity or blurring things on purpose actually loses you points so...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Right, one more try.
I still have time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This isn't right. It needs to stand out from the rest of the piece more...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It needs to be seen by everyone... It needs to be recognized...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Great job on the new song, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's already getting a lot of buzz too!
It has 200,000 views after just one day♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, and a lot of comments too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Oh, it's that person from before.
Wow, they already saw it...?)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <You can look at this art from so many different angles, so it's fun to see every time.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You have that look on your face, Ena.
Did you find a comment you like?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Ena. Have you finished your contest submission?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, an art contest.
A pretty serious one too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No way! You actually want to submit your work, Ena?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I am an artist, aren't I? It only seems natural to try to have my work be seen and recognized more.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I submitted my entry a week ago, so I think it'll be a little while until the results are announced.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm home.
*Sigh*... School was so exhausting...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I need to get changed and start working on our next song.

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line:
Welcome home.
Oh, a letter came for you.
It's from the Shibuya Art Contest.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line:
Shibuya Art Contest?
You submitted something...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Mom, give me that!
I'll open it in my room!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I'm sure it went well...
I drew that thing over and over again.
The one I submitted was my best one.)

rows.Speaker: Screening Result Form
rows.Line: <Thank you for submitting your piece into the Shibuya Art Contest.>

rows.Speaker: Screening Result Form
rows.Line: <We have completed our careful selection process and we regret to inform you that your piece will not be considered for any prizes.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No. It's not being considered for anything...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(No, that can't be true...!
I won't accept what he said!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Some people out there do like my art. Our N25 videos get so many comments saying so...)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Hey, who do you think makes the art for these videos?>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Dunno. N25 doesn't post credits or anything so...>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Honestly, the art isn't what draws me here, so I couldn't really care less.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Yeah, this person's style is kind of peculiar too.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Exactly. It's really N25's music that does it for me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So my art... Means nothing to them...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Without the music, my art is...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey...! Don't just barge in like...!

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line:
The contest results came, didn't they?
How did it go?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? That has nothing to do with you...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Or did you just come to gloat?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You said that I don't stand a chance, and you were right!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I submitted an entry anyways...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So what if I didn't...! Am I supposed to quit drawing now or something?!

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: You're free to do as your please. Keep drawing if that's what you want to do.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: But if you're serious about becoming a professional, you'll keep facing what you are now time and time again.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: The difference between those with talent and those without is that those without have to work much harder to be on the same level. More than you can imagine...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You don't have to tell me that!
I already know how hard it is!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No matter how hard I try, no one sees my art...! Even if some do, they end up feeling nothing...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I know just how hard it is!!
Way more than YOU do!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, look at me... I don't have anything...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No talent... Nothing... Not like you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, remember Marionette? It's still getting more views!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's up to 700,000 views now! How awesome is that?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Really...? Our other songs got only 300,000 views at most, so must be incredible.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Right?! I still can't really believe it♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Well, Yuki is her usual self...
But what's up, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Nothing? Aren't you happy...? This many views means that a ton of people must've seen what we made.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But my art's just an accessory for the song...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't understand what you're trying to say...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Well, fine then. I guess you especially wouldn't understand.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You put no thought or effort into what you make, but you still get praise and attention...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, hold on! Enanan, what's going on with you today?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm such an idiot. Taking my anger out on them even though it's pointless...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's not like it'll change anything...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow, I look awful...
Today's tag can be sick...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, no...! What's the point of getting attention like this...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But drawing feels pointless now too...
No one cares about my art...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So I'll just stop drawing for good...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This paint, my tablet... Everything! All of it can go!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, keep it down!
What's going on in there?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Whoa, what's up with your room?
It's a complete mess...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Shut up! Leave me alone!
I'm throwing it all out anyway.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, so keep it down... Hold on. You're throwing away your art stuff?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you sure? Doesn't it mean a lot to you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I feel like you'll regret doing this...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And if dad's the reason you're doing this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I said SHUT UP!!
Honestly, what do you care?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Get out!! Don't bother talking to me anymore!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Leave me alone! Don't tell me how much something means to me or that I'll regret it...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I just want to be by myself...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Yuki's feelings haven't really changed, so this place hasn't either...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I can come here and just do nothing.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The people that talk about me, the things I don't want to think about... None of it here...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hello. It felt like you were here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're not gonna ask what's happened to me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No. It seems like you don't want to talk...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry, but can I have some time to myself...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But nothing matters to me now.
Nothing at all...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Is Enanan gonna be okay? I sent her a few messages, but she hasn't even looked at any of them.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <And I wonder why she said that her art is just an accessory to our songs...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Our songs are reaching so many people because of her art and Amia's music videos.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I do. Since you two joined, we've been getting more and more views.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Her art provides a visual representation of the music, so it's easier for people to understand it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Which is why I can't say it's an accessory. I don't want her to think of it that way...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okay. Then we should try an talk to her one more time...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I don't know why she said what she did, but we should hear her out to get a better picture...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But where could she be...? I don't know where she lives and she probably won't come to our usual diner so...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A place where Enanan might be...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <When Yuki disappeared, she went to SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So I think Enanan might've gone there too...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh... Right! Then let's all go together!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I won't understand what she's going to say, so me being there may be pointless.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, okay... If Enanan really is there, the two of us will do what we can to convince her!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, we thought that Ena might be here so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Let's all go see her!
We need to tell her how we feel!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Miku, can you tell us where Ena is?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She may not want to talk. She wants to be alone and not see anyone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But we still don't know yet...
If we talk to her she just might...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh yeah. The same thing happened with Mafuyu too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Which is why I'm here now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <O-Of course I want my artwork to be seen by as many people as possible...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But I'm not drawing just for likes. I enjoy making illustrations, simple as that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Ena doesn’t really want to be alone...
She just wants to be...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Miku, I still think we should go talk to Ena...
You want to help her that much?
Then allow me to join you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What...?! It's not just Miku anymore?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, it was just me until now.
But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just like when the marionette appeared here, this place may be changing as well...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh, I'm not sure I really understand, but I guess it's a good thing?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, but how do you plan on helping her.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Even if we find her, she still may not want to talk to anyone else or run away even...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's only one thing I can do.

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm glad you liked it.
But what's taking your sister so long?
It seemed like she was awake...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No idea. The way she was, it might be a while before she comes downstairs.

rows.Speaker: Mom
rows.Line: Then I'll put some plastic wrap on it for now. I need to finish up the housework, so could you put your dishes in the sink, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Did you say something to Ena about that contest?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It seemed like you did the same thing when she was still in middle school. Can't you do a little easier on her?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, she's nowhere near your level, but that doesn't seem like a reason to...

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: Being an artist means being alone...

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: At times, you have to keep drawing even when no one will look regardless of talent or skill.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: And making a living out of it is hardly an easy task. You'll never find it without talent or being fully committed.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: But those that wish to pursue this path despite these hurdles will have to endure quite a bit of suffering...

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: It's not just about skill or technique. I simply don't believe Ena can handle that pain.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: Because it's such a cruel and unforgiving path.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: I thought that I needed to tell her honestly what she would be facing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I get what you want to say, Dad...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In whatever field, the ones without talent have to work a hundred times harder than the ones with talent. I've even experienced that myself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
And Ena with her personality...
I get that it'll be rough...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But isn't what Ena wants to hear something a lot simpler than that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She's just like you, Dad. She loves art. Of course she'd be hurt if you told her what you did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What if you saw your daughter's art just as a father and not as an artist...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(With no words either, just a melody.
But it's so soothing...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's a gentle but sort of sad tone...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No... I just want to forget it all...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The coloring makes this illustration look filthy.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Now look here! I deliberately chose that color theme because the picture's supposed to portray a messy sort of atmosphere!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Sigh... I think I'll log off now. There's only a few minor adjustments left to make so...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then I'll log off after I get a look at it♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No way. Not until it's completely done.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't know much about actual art, but I can tell you this at least...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So please give it your best shot.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That voice is coming from this way...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Is that the VIRTUAL SINGER, Rin...?
But what's she doing here?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No one else besides Miku's supposed to be here, right?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Are you Ena...?
Nice to meet you. I'm Rin.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hold on, why are you even here?
Miku was the only one here until now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's why I was singing.
So that this song would reach you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I just want to forget all about art and everything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because it just makes me jealous and miserable...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No one looks. They don't even care when they do.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So I want to forget it all...
That's why I came here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But then... I heard you singing, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you sure? Doesn't it mean a lot to you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I feel like you'll regret doing this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Of course I don't want to quit...!
I don't want to give up!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But there's just no point in trying any harder!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No one will acknowledge my work. No recognition. As if my art didn't even exist!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You really can't draw unless someone appreciates your art?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I just can't unless someone does...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean... Even I want to...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If that's how you truly feel, then that may be so...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But the others probably don't think so.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's why Kanade and the others entrusted this song to us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So that you'll come to realize it, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you felt something real after hearing this song, you should go and talk to them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They'll wait for you as long as they have to.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I am. I'm sorry for making you worry so much...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And thank you for the song, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're welcome. I was hoping you'd hear it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade made that song just for you, Ena. She just knocked the melody and stuff out crazy fast by getting into the zone or something!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I needed her to hear it as soon as possible so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Your songs really are nice and gentle...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It felt so warm and made my heart sink a little, but I immediately got that you wanted to get those feelings across...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want you to draw something for this song, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want to see how you visualize it and what you'll make...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I... I want to draw too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No matter how much I draw, no one recognizes my art. It didn't feel like I was doing anything at all...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I thought that my art was being appreciated since they were a part of these songs but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: In the end, no one acknowledges my art unless it has music attached to it. No one cares unless I say that I'm the artist for N25...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My father even told me a while back that I don't have any talent...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was so frustrated by that and I kept on drawing to prove him wrong...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it's just like he said. I really don't have any talent. I really won't get any recognition...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And if that's the case, then there's no point in me drawing anymore...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I hate myself for thinking that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I hate the part of me that can't draw unless they get some sort of attention...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You say that you don't have any talent, Ena, but I don't think so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's not what this is! Your dad or these others may not acknowledge your art, but at the very least, I like what you draw.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I don't believe that you're the kind of person that needs recognition in order to draw, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's why I was drawn to your art.
That's why I asked you to join N25...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If you need acknowledgement from someone, then I'll do just that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: N25 needs you, Ena. It needs your art.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! We're the ones that really appreciate you as an artist!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is there something wrong with wanting to be appreciated?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why do you hate the part of you that wants attention?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If no one acknowledges or recognizes you now, just keep drawing until someone does.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We have to keep creating what we do anyway so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why do you make it sound so easy?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sigh...
My head was a complete mess, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll try drawing something. I don't know if it'll be any good, but I'll try.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sigh...
Wow, my room's a mess.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'd like to draw now, but cleaning up might have to come first.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And getting my paint cleaned and sorted is gonna be such a pain. Everything else is all over the place too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, I can start by getting them back on the shelf and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? This is... My old sketch book?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I haven't seen this in ages. It's from back in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, I used to be terrible. I guess I just learned to wet wash, but the paper is all bent out of shape now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And this was when I decided to become an artist...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But now... I'm different from that girl with her head in the clouds.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, little me... Is it really okay for me to keep drawing like this?

rows.Speaker: Ena's friend A
rows.Line: Hey, Ena. Did you decide what you want to do yet?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: No, but I think I'll try for a fine arts school.

rows.Speaker: Ena's friend B
rows.Line: Oh, right. You're always saying that you want to become an artist.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. My dad's an artist too, and his art's what always made me want to draw so...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: I want to become an even better artist than him, and thought I should learn as much as I can as soon as possible.

rows.Speaker: Ena's friend A
rows.Line: That's great! Maybe I should get your autograph now while I still can.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Really? Now? Well, just you wait!
I'm definitely gonna be famous one day!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: So only these two high schools have fine arts programs... This one focuses on the fundamentals, but this one let's you learn from an actual pro...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Learn the basics or learn from a pro. My fundamentals should be pretty good, but I live with a pro too so...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
I wonder which would be better.
I'll ask dad. He might know.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: I want to go to a school with a fine arts program but can't decide between these two. They both sound really great but...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I want to be an artist so...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: I thought I should learn as much as I can right now...

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: You don't have the talent to become an artist.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Wh-What are you saying?!
You're joking, right?
That's not funny, you know?

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line:
I'm not joking.
You don't have any talent.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: But there's no way that's true. I've been drawing since I was little and even got special prizes in middle school for my art...

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: Yes, I know. But there are countless others hoping to do the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: Unless you can win the grand prize at a big contest, then no one will recognize you.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Why are you saying this now?
You never did until this point.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: I'm serious about this, but you just...!

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: You won't be able to become the kind of artist you're envisioning.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: If you had talent with the resolve to match, then things may be different...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Was everything I did until now just a complete waste of time then?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: I don't have any talent, so it doesn't matter how hard I work?!

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line:
Yes...
The world I live in works just as you say.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: No doors will open for you as you are now.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: You have no right to decide that...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: It's my future, so stay out of it!!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: I get that you're not gonna be of any help now...! I'll become an even greater artist than you on my own!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And I couldn't even get into the school I wanted to go to and nobody gave me a second thought...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The people listening to N25, the judges form the contest, even him...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have no talent. I knew that even before I sent in my submission to that contest.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But the others... They said they need my art...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Which is why I can't give up just yet.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Kanade made that song for me, so I have to do everything I can in return...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It blew up into a huge piece and...
Wait, it's night already?
No wonder I'm tired...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I should apologize to Akito about what I said yesterday too, but he's probably asleep now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess I can show everyone what I made and go to bed after that too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Everyone, sorry for the wait. Are you still up?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, Enanan! You never showed up, so we started to get worried!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I wanted some time to focus, and I'm all done now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, just a second to send it and...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Is this a girl looking up at the sky after it stopped raining...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, and your song sort of shined a light on my heart when I heard it so I tried including that as part of it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <This is awesome! The rays of light piercing through the clouds are sooo pretty too!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hehe. I worked pretty hard on that and spent a lot of time getting it right.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So this is how you saw my song then.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm happy it turned out like this...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <R-Really? I think you're exaggerating a bit...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You know there's no point. She'll just criticize it and move on.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <How? I'm just saying what I feel.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Y-You understand what I was trying to draw...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yawn... Huh? It's morning already?
I guess I passed out from exhaustion.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, I almost forgot...
I need to apologize to Akito.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: He should still be home so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Um, I'm sorry about yesterday.
Lashing out at you like that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Nah, forget about it.
It's not any different from usual.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hold on, it was not the same as always!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Calm down, will you?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, but I decided to keep drawing too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I talked to dad about it too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He isn't trying to be mean or anything. He was worried about you, but not expressing it in the best way is all.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't like how he said what he did either, so Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm heading back to my room now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sigh... I guess things won't go that easy, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (He's saying this now? Honestly, the nerve on that...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey! Who said you could look at my art?! Give it back...!

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: The light shining through the rain clouds contrast well against the darkness.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: This girl's worries seem like they're about to vanish as well.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: But your choice of colors is a bit off. You came up with a good design, but the colors are out of balance.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What was that?! And that jab at the end!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But now that he mentioned it, the colors do seem sort of unbalanced...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's not like I'm sending this in anywhere but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess I can touch it up a little more.
